recommendation: Adopt Claude's round-2 recommendation after correcting C1's authority and trigger language. Record OD-112-3 as the final fail-closed policy. Keep OD-112-1 and OD-112-2 under the DR-112 Security + operations authority and OD-112-4 under its expressly reserved product/release authority; leave each unresolved unless its actual authority supplies a value or a concrete parking disposition with a real trigger. Any such parking has no Condition-2 or D-056 eligibility effect without a separate reviewed act and a successor join. Retain Claude's C2 and C3 sequences. For C4, first adopt an application-grade successor that makes the proposed grammar governing, then populate complete profiles; ikconfigParserVectors and NT-TCB-KEXEC remain unresolved unless their governing evidence is authored. rationale: Claude's central correction is supported by the bytes. D-056 gates 2 and 3 exclude authoring, missing design, and still-UNDECIDED numbers and require every true remainder to be already named at a condition-4/DR-G obligation with an owner. D-006 clause 5 instead records a narrow, concrete G05 trigger; it is not a general eligibility rule. D-056 expressly preserves the D-002/D-010 row-level deferral limb, while D-132 still requires later process acts to receive their own D-000 cycles and D-134 only changes the affected-row set for DR-131 and DR-133. D-007 and the C2 join support Claude's matrix-before-threshold sequence, and the C3 join supports remasurement plus one coherent set of evaluable windows. Two qualifications remain. First, Claude's C1 phrase 'deciding authority (row owner cell)' is not faithful for OD-112-4: the live DR-112 row owner is Security + operations, but signed-index-trust-contract.v8 expressly reserves OD-112-4 and its waiver duration to product/release; the round-2 text also does not expressly preserve the round-1 real-trigger requirement. Second, platform-tcb-leftover-join.v9 keeps ikconfigParserVectors and NT-TCB-KEXEC inside OBL-RESERVED-TABLES with leftoverDesign true, existingGate none, execution owner none, and not-capable-of-riding. The G22-evidence wording occurs in platform-tcb-contract.v45, whose operative standing is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and binds NOTHING. Claude's cross-cutting no-eligibility concession is therefore sound only if that C4 wording is treated as a non-operative description rather than current routing.
